verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online docs explicitly document automated payment reminders ('Avoid late payments with automated payment reminders'), statement reminders for late-paying customers, and A/R aging reports to identify overdue accounts, directly matching the reminders half of the story. Recurring invoices themselves are not explicitly named in the evidence pack, though invoicing automation (billable hours auto-added, AI-drafted invoices) is well documented. Missing for 10: explicit first-party mention of 'recurring invoice' scheduling feature and independent/hands-on corroboration of reminder automation working as described.
